production_gate: choose conservatively on development only; one weighting trial and one full-tuning trial; no recursive search; evaluate frozen test after final export
experimental_scope: four single-dataset pilots, one mixed reference, at most one weighting pilot, one full-tuning pilot, one final production fit; no omission, rank, partial-tuning or extra-seed sweep

audio_quality.chime_opening_beep_policy: reserve complete speech-labelled annotations overlapping session seconds 0-1; never trim each utterance
audio_quality.interpretation: Amplitude audit, not an intelligibility or SNR estimate; quarantine near-silent labelled speech and reduce quiet-view influence within each source
